implementation: Microsoft Windows 10 Anniversary Update, Windows Server 2016, Windows Storage Server 2016; Microsoft Surface Book, Surface Pro 4, Surface Pro 3 and Surface 3 w/ Windows 10 Anniversary Update; Microsoft Lumia 950 and Lumia 650 w/ Windows 10 Mobile Anniversary Update SymCrypt Cryptographic Implementations
description: The Microsoft Windows Next Generation Cryptographic algorithm implementation provides enhanced support for AES, AES DRBG, HMAC, SHS (SHA), and Triple-DES. All implementations are packaged into a library used by Microsoft and other third-party applications.
